capabilities: Sync vault folders to external local directories as multiple folder pairs
Choose one-way (with cleanup) or newer-file-wins two-way mode per pair
Copy embedded attachments next to their notes in the destination
Auto-sync on an interval or on file change, or sync manually
Show sync progress and results in a status bar item
disambiguation: Not cross-device vault sync; it syncs vault folders to absolute local paths on the same machine, and must be built from source.
extras: Desktop-only (needs filesystem access) and not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; no marketplace-style install — users must build the bundle and copy dist files into the plugin folder. Settings include a Buy Me a Coffee donation link that opens an external site.
problem: Vault folders may need to live in sync with directories outside the vault (e.g. a backup or another workspace), which Obsidian's own sync features do not cover.
summary: Folder sync plugin that mirrors vault folders to external local directories, with per-pair one-way or two-way modes and embedded-file copying.
